module_summary: Parallel-to-serial converter: a 2-bit counter loads the 4-bit input every fourth cycle into a rotating shift register whose MSB drives the serial output, with a valid pulse on load.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: 4-bit shift register loaded from d and rotated left each cycle

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter selecting load versus shift every four cycles

anchors.name: dout
anchors.why: Serial output bit taken from data MSB

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: Pulse marking first serial bit of each new word

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: 4-bit parallel input loaded into data when cnt is 3

groups.name: p2s_shifter
groups.description: Shift register serializing 4-bit words MSB first

groups.name: bit_counter
groups.description: Counter sequencing load and producing the valid pulse
